name: The Beatles
hook: From Liverpool to Abbey Road: the handful of facts Jeopardy keeps asking about the Fab Four.

facts.label: Liverpool
facts.statement: They formed in Liverpool; their first Cavern Club show, in 1961, paid the group five pounds total.

facts.label: "I Want to Hold Your Hand"
facts.statement: "I Want to Hold Your Hand" was their first American No. 1, in 1964.
associations: I Want to Hold Your Hand

facts.label: Pete Best
facts.statement: Brian Epstein fired drummer Pete Best in 1962, and Ringo Starr replaced him.

facts.label: A Hard Day's Night
facts.statement: A Hard Day's Night was their first film, with Wilfrid Brambell as Paul's "clean old man" grandfather.

facts.label: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band
facts.statement: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band introduced Billy Shears and used 42 London Symphony players on "A Day in the Life."

facts.label: Abbey Road
facts.statement: The Abbey Road cover shows the four walking across a zebra crossing in Camden.

facts.label: "The Long and Winding Road"
facts.statement: "The Long and Winding Road," from Let It Be, was their 20th and final US No. 1.
